One compiled error remains; deterministic compiler output is a model aid, not model authority.
Shuffled relevance prior can corrupt 4B behavior even when facts remain present; SelectionReceipt/ProjectionProof and prior provenance remain necessary.
A real 4B reader benefits strongly from small certified views, strengthening the C6 case for a deterministic view/router before model interpretation.

Hosted 4B evidence supports reader architecture only; Qwen full-model adaptation, local runtime and live cognition remain open.
Representation/projection is demonstrably causal at the 4B reader surface: compiled-vs-raw COVE changed accuracy by +58.3 points.

delta: Embedding role reversal can score more similar than role-preserving paraphrase (0.9918 vs 0.9362; second pair 0.9860 vs 0.9685).
Therefore recurrence/organization identity cannot use dense similarity alone; directed roles and semantic classes must be explicit in E-CERT2 candidate identity.
4B representation sensitivity is a confound/control variable, not emergence evidence.
Actual Nemotron 4B CC10: raw L0 12/16; typed L1 13/16; compact symbolic arm noncompliant.
Typed semantics improve this 4B slightly but cost 733 vs 405 prompt tokens; canonical correctness and reader efficiency remain separate objectives.
The compact failure strengthens the requirement that P2/native symbols be trained/learned and verified rather than assumed from terseness.
NVIDIA embedding geometry strongly aliases direction: role reversal exceeded paraphrase similarity in two relation pairs.
Semantic-class tags FACT/ACTIVATION/PROPOSAL/AUTHORITY shift embeddings but stay highly similar (0.839-0.881), so embedding distance cannot enforce semantic firebreaks.
Deterministic typed projection can improve 4B usability, but runtime-enforced casts remain the security mechanism; textual/embedding labels are not authority boundaries.
NVIDIA embeddings are operational at 1024 dimensions and can support retrieval experiments, but role-reversal aliasing forbids using vector similarity as canonical graph identity.

The matched prior experiment demonstrates behavioral influence and a catastrophic shuffled-prior negative control (0/8), but neutral/truthful arms violated the output contract; beneficial latent-field effect is NOT established.
G1d should remain HOLD; future field tests need stronger output/scoring protocol, prior provenance and field-strength calibration.

shared_conclusion: The NVIDIA evidence strengthens deterministic certified model views and strengthens warnings against treating vector/latent relevance as truth, role identity or authority. It does not justify canonical promotion or close live/Qwen/hardware/training questions.
